actor_order: List the forklift ID first and the pedestrian ID second.
timestamp_rule: Use MM:SS with zero padding. For each continuous approach, record the first second when the minimum clearance is clearly visible.
near_miss_definition: Record an event only when a moving forklift and a pedestrian on foot pass within less than one pedestrian body width in the same open operating lane.
The moment must show an evasive stop, hesitation, or sidestep by either side.
Do not log safe passes with clearly larger clearance.
Do not log interactions separated by a fixed barrier, rack line, or wall.
Do not duplicate one continuous approach across multiple adjacent frames.

summary_codes.crossing_conflict: forklift cut across the pedestrian crossing path at close range
summary_codes.reverse_conflict: reversing forklift forced the pedestrian to stop at close range

clips.setting: Top-view aisle crossing with labeled actors F1, F2, P1, and P2.
Top-view dock approach with labeled actors F3, F4, P3, and P4.
